input.free_text_description: This system is a e-commerce platform that serves Customer, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for authentication, jwt, cart. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Customer, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As a Customer, I want to add items to my cart and complete a purchase, so that I can buy products conveniently.
As a Customer, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents when needed.
As a Customer, I want to interact with category functionality, so that I can accomplish my category-related tasks.
